name: Assistant · Reminders and follow-ups
description: Every 10 minutes: meeting reminders, follow-ups to quiet leads, and the check after a meeting.

parameters.content:
## Reminders and follow-ups (every 10 minutes)
Messages the assistant sends on its own, on the channel the lead last wrote from, through **Send message** (outside WhatsApp's 24-hour window as an approved template; on Messenger a reminder goes with the event-update tag). Each is claimed in the database before it is sent, so none goes twice.
- **Reminders**: a day before a meeting booked more than a day ahead, and an hour before.
- **Follow-ups**: when the lead went quiet after the assistant's message: the first repeats the open question (inside WhatsApp's 24 hours), the last one says how to stop. Only while the assistant handles the conversation, before a booking, in the business's daytime; never after an opt-out. Timing: `follow_up.after_hours` in the profile.
- **After a meeting**: the team is asked in Slack whether it happened (👍 / 👎, see Team replies); after a no-show the lead is offered another time.

parameters.query:
-- Reminders due now, each claimed once: a day before a meeting booked more than a day ahead, and an
-- hour before one booked at least 90 minutes ahead.
WITH day AS (
  UPDATE assistant.bookings SET reminded_24h_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE status = 'booked' AND reminded_24h_at IS NULL AND starts_at <= now() + interval '24 hours'
    AND starts_at > now() + interval '2 hours' AND created_at < starts_at - interval '24 hours'
  RETURNING id, 'reminder_24h' AS kind
), hour AS (
  UPDATE assistant.bookings SET reminded_1h_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE status = 'booked' AND reminded_1h_at IS NULL AND starts_at <= now() + interval '1 hour'
    AND starts_at > now() AND created_at < starts_at - interval '90 minutes'
  RETURNING id, 'reminder_1h' AS kind
)
SELECT k.kind, b.conversation_id, b.label AS meeting, b.agent, b.starts_at AS start, c.name,
       coalesce(c.language, 'en') AS language, c.facts->>'intent' AS intent
FROM (SELECT * FROM day UNION ALL SELECT * FROM hour) k
JOIN assistant.bookings b ON b.id = k.id
JOIN assistant.contacts c ON c.id = b.contact_id
WHERE c.opted_out_at IS NULL AND b.conversation_id IS NOT NULL

-- Leads who went quiet after the assistant's message, each touch claimed once (follow_ups counts the
-- touches since the lead last wrote). Touch n goes $1[n] hours after the lead's last message.
WITH quiet AS (
  SELECT v.id,
         CASE WHEN v.followed_up_at > v.last_inbound_at THEN v.follow_ups ELSE 0 END AS done,
         (SELECT m.channel FROM assistant.messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = v.id AND m.direction = 'in'
          ORDER BY m.sent_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS channel
  FROM assistant.conversations v JOIN assistant.contacts c ON c.id = v.contact_id
  WHERE v.status = 'open' AND v.mode = 'ai' AND c.opted_out_at IS NULL AND c.stage IN ('new', 'qualifying', 'qualified')
    AND v.last_inbound_at IS NOT NULL AND v.last_outbound_at > v.last_inbound_at
    AND extract(hour FROM now() AT TIME ZONE $2) BETWEEN 9 AND 18
), touch AS (
  UPDATE assistant.conversations v SET follow_ups = q.done + 1, followed_up_at = now()
  FROM quiet q
  WHERE v.id = q.id AND q.done < cardinality($1::int[])
    AND v.last_inbound_at < now() - make_interval(hours => ($1::int[])[q.done + 1])
    -- Messenger and Instagram allow messages only within 24 hours of the lead's last one.
    AND (q.channel NOT IN ('messenger', 'instagram') OR ($1::int[])[q.done + 1] < 24)
  RETURNING v.id, v.follow_ups
)
SELECT CASE WHEN t.follow_ups = cardinality($1::int[]) THEN 'last_follow_up' ELSE 'follow_up' END AS kind,
       t.id AS conversation_id, c.name, coalesce(c.language, 'en') AS language, c.facts->>'intent' AS intent,
       coalesce(c.facts->>'area', c.facts->>'property_area') AS area,
       (SELECT json_build_object('text', m.text, 'quick_replies', m.quick_replies) FROM assistant.messages m
        WHERE m.conversation_id = t.id AND m.direction = 'out' AND m.author = 'ai' AND m.status = 'sent'
        ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last
FROM touch t JOIN assistant.conversations v ON v.id = t.id JOIN assistant.contacts c ON c.id = v.contact_id

-- Leads the team marked as a no-show: offered another time, once.
WITH due AS (
  UPDATE assistant.bookings SET no_show_messaged_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE status = 'no_show' AND no_show_messaged_at IS NULL AND conversation_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT 'no_show' AS kind, b.conversation_id, b.label AS meeting, b.agent, c.name,
       coalesce(c.language, 'en') AS language, c.facts->>'intent' AS intent
FROM due JOIN assistant.bookings b ON b.id = due.id JOIN assistant.contacts c ON c.id = b.contact_id
WHERE c.opted_out_at IS NULL

-- Meetings that ended at least 30 minutes ago: the team is asked once whether they happened.
WITH due AS (
  UPDATE assistant.bookings SET outcome_asked_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  WHERE status = 'booked' AND outcome_asked_at IS NULL AND ends_at < now() - interval '30 minutes'
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT b.id AS booking_id, b.label, b.agent, b.starts_at, c.name, v.slack_thread_ts
FROM due JOIN assistant.bookings b ON b.id = due.id JOIN assistant.contacts c ON c.id = b.contact_id
LEFT JOIN assistant.conversations v ON v.id = b.conversation_id
UPDATE assistant.bookings SET outcome_slack_ts = $2 WHERE id = $1::bigint RETURNING id
